laat_vaar.voor: jy tel een jaar vir elke sekonde
laat_vaar.na: jy tel elke sekonde een jaar
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'one year for every second' is English phrasing; 'elke sekonde een jaar' is the natural Afrikaans order with the same meaning and no longer words.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Distributive 'een jaar vir elke sekonde' is ordinary Afrikaans, not an anglicism, and the proposal invites a garden-path misreading ('jy tel elke sekonde' = you count every second) for a Grade 5 reader, so it is a lateral move at best.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected entry capitalises 'Kennisstelsels', but the lesson writes 'Inheemse kennisstelsels (IKS)' in the study text and 'inheemse kennisstelsels (IKS)' as the glossary headword. Lower case is correct Afrikaans for a common noun, so the lesson should keep it; I proposed no change, but a person may want the protected entry aligned so a case-sensitive check does not report a mismatch.

Low confidence: the AWS may prefer the attributive compound 'goedbewaarde' over 'goed bewaarde'. Not changed because it is protected; a person could confirm against the AWS and, if needed, change it in the lesson and the spec together.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Van die oudste rotse op aarde
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A range is normally given from the smaller to the larger number; same span, same meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: It reorders a number range, and numbers are not a language agent's to touch; oldest-to-youngest is also an ordinary way to give a geological age range.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: kan daardie plek ook heilig wees
laat_vaar_vorige.na: kan dieselfde plek ook heilig wees
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The block's point is one place with two values, and 'dieselfde' says so; note it adds a three-syllable word where the gate's syllable limit is reportedly tight.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'daardie plek ook' already ties back to 'daar' and the heading says 'Een plek', so this is a lateral move that adds a three-syllable word where the gate's syllable limit is tight.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wat geskryf word as 'n 1 met nege nulle
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wat as 'n 1 met nege nulle geskryf word
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: In an Afrikaans subordinate clause the verb cluster goes to the end; the original follows English word order.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: It rewords a glossary definition for style only, and putting the 'as' phrase after the verb is normal, grammatical Afrikaans (compare 'wat bekend staan as').

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: This is a general statement about IKS, and the definite article suggests particular ancestors nobody has named yet; the general form reads more naturally.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'met die voorouers' is natural Afrikaans for ancestors collectively, so dropping the article is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The study text gives this definition as 'vir die mensdom of vir 'n gemeenskap'; repeating 'vir' makes the glossary entry match it exactly and makes the two parallel parts clearer.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Leaving out the second 'vir' is normal, correct Afrikaans; the glossary entry need not copy the study sentence word for word, and the change would reword a definition with no grammar fault to fix.
